sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive form. The league leaders are on a five-game winning streak and sit comfortably atop the table with 22 points from 10 games. Alsager Town arrive in poor shape, winless in their last five matches and propping up the division with just 4 points, making this a highly favourable fixture for Sandbach's continued push.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a critical away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on the leaders after drawing their most recent game. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between third and fifth place, with both teams among the division's strongest performers, though AFC Bridgnorth's recent loss to Wolverhampton Casuals suggests momentum may be shifting. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a fixture between mid-table sides with contrasting recent form—the visitors won their last outing while Wednesfield have alternated wins and losses. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town in a meeting of two consistent performers, with Bilston currently sixth on an excellent run. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a clash of struggling sides; New Mills are mid-table but have lost their last two, while Market Drayton sit tenth with recent mixed results. Shawbury United travel to Barnton seeking to recover after a harsh five-game losing streak, while Barnton have stabilized somewhat with a recent win. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter between two teams severely short on wins. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between sides in mid-to-lower table positions, with Allscott showing recent improvement. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, pitting a team in mid-table doldrums against the division's worst-performing side, winless in seven matches.
